There are currently two types of magic weapons in the game, wands and staffs. I want to start with wands though, because
in general, they have great utility during an adventure as they are one-handed magic weapons that you can
use a shield with. The core types of wands are named a bit differently than the bows, which are quite
straightforward. But they do follow the same tier and upgrade material types. They are actually pretty simple to
progress due to the fact there are no special or masterwork wands aside from the best in slot wand that you can

magic logs is the tier eight ancestral wand. This weapon is incredible and out of all the craftable core tier eights,
this is one of the ones I recommend the most as wands can attack with all elemental magic types making them very
versatile depending on the weakness of your opponent. An ancestral wand paired with a good shield makes you very tanky
and whilst there might be higher DPS options with the staffs, the overall ease of use, utility and cheap upkeep
with runes makes the ancestral wand a great weapon to have. This gives wands a very important use for certain boss

the wands, there are also several special and masterwork staffs that we can take a look at. First off, we'll
take a look at the tier eight core craftable ancestral staff. This weapon shares its attacks with all other core

caps at the ancestral staff. The attacks of staffs can be changed by swapping what elemental magic you are casting.

sky on enemies. The special attack mimics the greatest offensive might of the dragons, their dragon breath.
